title: Tightened slack constants on paid padded triple covers: conditional κ = 4.13596659368e-4
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Extends PR #137's draft candidate by one instantiation choice: the retained 47-constraint assembly is instantiated with beta = 10^-12 and backoff = 10^-16 instead of the legacy beta = 10^-6, backoff 10^-14 that PR #137 inherits from the PR104-era lineage (#97 used beta = 1/4; the batched assembly 1/1000; #104 10^-6; machinery unchanged; the strict constraints involve beta only through positivity and leaf-ordering margins, checked at exact rationals; the complex side binds, so the assembly bit saving is exactly (1-beta)*b - backoff).

Everything else is byte-identical to PR #137: the padded bit provider with paid padding deltas, the padded cover geometry, the weighted local-ring compilation, the finite bridge, all routers, reserves and charges.

Result, under all of PR #137's retained hypotheses (inherited analytic/tape/uniform batching/borrowed-row interfaces remain written proof dependencies):

kappa = 206798323483/500000000000000 = 4.13596646966e-4,

413,264 grid points (denominator 10^15) above PR #137's 4.13596233702e-4, the furthest published value at submission. The next 10^-15 kappa grid point is rejected by PR #137's own check. No new physical execution is claimed and no global optimality is claimed; this is an instantiation refinement in the genre of #61, #100, #107 and my #136.

## Validation

`research/tightened-slack/certificate-tight.py --write` re-runs PR #137's own certificate chain end to end from its pinned inputs (SHA-256 pins in SOURCE.json) at the refined constants: padded bit provider checks, padded geometry checks, finite bridge, kappa bracket with next-10^-15-grid-point rejection, and all 47 strict constraints and 7 margins. The regenerated certificate prints PASS kappa 206798323483/500000000000000, complex saving unchanged at 413939067/10^12. All construction credit belongs to the inherited lineage as recorded in NOTICE/SOURCES: PR131's physical word and cover-local reuse, PR #137's paid padded triple covers (eumemic), and every earlier interface those PRs attribute.

Note: this branch is one commit carrying PR #137's draft tree plus the tightened instantiation, so the certificate is runnable from this branch alone. `.github/` is left at base-`main`'s state, so no CI workflow changes are proposed.
